description: This file defines the `InvokableObjectManager` class, a core component responsible for managing invokable objects within the Orleans distributed runtime. It handles registration, deregistration, message dispatching, and orchestrates the asynchronous processing of messages for local objects, including message pumping and response handling.

classes.name: InvokableObjectManager
classes.description: Manages invokable objects, handles message dispatching, registration, deregistration, and message processing in Orleans.

classes.name: InvokableObjectManager.LocalObjectData
classes.description: Represents local object data associated with an observer, manages message queue and message pump for an individual object.

methods.name: InvokableObjectManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies and internal state.

methods.name: TryRegister
methods.description: Attempts to register an object with a specific ObserverGrainId.

methods.name: TryDeregister
methods.description: Attempts to deregister an object by its ObserverGrainId.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a message to the appropriate local object if exists.
